articles.title_en: The Impact of Income-Driven Repayment on Student Borrower Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 收入驱动还款对学生借款人结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: In the United States, most student loans follow a fixed payment schedule that falls early in borrowers’ careers. This structure provides no insurance against earnings risk and may increase student loan defaults. Income-driven repayment (IDR) plans are designed to help distressed student borrowers by lowering their monthly payments to a share of income. Using random variation in a loan servicer’s automatic dialing system, I find that IDR reduces delinquencies by 22 percentage points and decreases outstanding balances within eight months of take-up. I find suggestive long-run impacts on borrower credit scores, mortgage-holding rates, and other measures of financial health. (JEL G23, G51, H52, I22)
articles.abstract_cn: 在美国，大多数学生贷款采用固定还款计划，该计划在借款人职业生涯早期即开始还款。这种结构无法为收入风险提供保险，并可能增加学生贷款违约。收入驱动还款（IDR）计划旨在通过将月还款额降低至收入的一定比例来帮助陷入困境的学生借款人。利用贷款服务机构自动拨号系统的随机变异，我发现IDR在参与后八个月内将拖欠率降低了22个百分点，并减少了未偿余额。我发现了对借款人信用评分、抵押贷款持有率及其他财务健康指标的长期影响的暗示性证据。（JEL G23, G51, H52, I22）

articles.title_en: Winners and Losers? The Effect of Gaining and Losing Access to Selective Colleges on Education and Labor Market Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 赢家与输家？获得和失去选择性大学入学机会对教育与劳动力市场结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: We use the introduction of the Texas Top Ten Percent rule to estimate the effect of access to a selective college on graduation and earnings outcomes for two groups of students. For highly ranked students at more disadvantaged high schools, who gained access under the policy, college enrollment and graduation increased. Less highly ranked students at more advantaged schools, who tended to lose access, shifted toward less-selective colleges under the policy, but did not see declines in overall college enrollment, graduation, or earnings. The policy thus benefited students targeted for admission without evidence of adverse effects on displaced students. (JEL I21, I23, I24, I26)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用德克萨斯州前百分之十规则的引入，估计了获得选择性大学入学机会对两组学生的毕业和收入结果的影响。对于在劣势高中排名靠前的学生，他们在该政策下获得了入学机会，大学入学率和毕业率有所提高。在优势学校排名较低的学生，他们往往失去入学机会，在政策下转向选择性较低的大学，但整体大学入学率、毕业率或收入并未下降。因此，该政策惠及了针对入学的学生，而没有证据表明对受替代的学生产生不利影响。(JEL I21, I23, I24, I26)

articles.title_en: A Glimpse of Freedom: Allied Occupation and Political Resistance in East Germany
articles.title_cn: 自由的惊鸿一瞥：盟军占领与东德的政治抵抗
articles.abstract_en: This paper exploits the idiosyncratic line of contact separating Allied and Soviet troops within East Germany at the end of WWII to study political resistance in a non-democracy. When Nazi Germany surrendered, 40 percent of what would become the authoritarian German Democratic Republic was initially under Allied control but was ceded to Soviet control less than two months later. Brief Allied exposure increased protests during the major 1953 uprising. We use novel data on the appointment of local mayors and a retrospective survey to argue that even a “glimpse of freedom” can foster civilian opposition to dictatorship. (JEL D72, D74, N44, P16)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用二战结束时盟军与苏军在东德境内接触线的特殊划分，研究非民主体制下的政治抵抗。当纳粹德国投降时，后来成为威权主义德意志民主共和国的地区中有40%最初处于盟军控制之下，但在不到两个月后被割让给苏联控制。短暂的盟军占领增加了1953年重大起义期间的抗议活动。我们使用关于地方市长任命的新数据和一项回顾性调查来论证，即使是“自由的惊鸿一瞥”也能激发平民对独裁统治的反对。(JEL D72, D74, N44, P16)

articles.title_en: Employer Responses to Family Leave Programs
articles.title_cn: 雇主对家庭休假计划的回应
articles.abstract_en: Search frictions make worker turnover costly to firms. A three-month parental leave expansion in Sweden provides exogenous variation that we use to quantify firms’ adjustment costs upon worker absence. The reform increased women’s leave duration and likelihood of separating from pre-birth employers. Firms with greater exposure to the reform hired additional workers and increased coworkers to make it coworkers’ hours, incurring wage costs corresponding to 10 full-time equivalent months in addition to replacing the workers. These adjustment costs varied by firms’ availability of internal substitutes. We also analyze a daddy-month reform and find similar employer responses to male workers’ leave, albeit smaller in magnitude. (JEL J16, J22, J32, J64, M52)
articles.abstract_cn: 搜索摩擦使得工人流动对企业而言成本高昂。瑞典一项为期三个月的育儿假扩展提供了外生变异，我们利用其来量化工人缺勤时企业的调整成本。该改革增加了女性休假时长及离开产前雇主的可能性。受改革影响较大的企业雇佣了额外工人，并增加了同事的工作时间，除了替换工人外，还产生了相当于10个全职等效月工资成本的费用。这些调整成本因企业内部替代者的可用性而异。我们还分析了父亲月改革，发现雇主对男性工人休假的类似回应，尽管规模较小。(JEL J16, J22, J32, J64, M52)

articles.title_en: Labor Supply and Directed Technical Change: Evidence from the Termination of the Bracero Program in 1964
articles.title_cn: 劳动力供给与定向技术变革：来自1964年布拉塞罗计划终止的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of labor supply on the creation of new technology, exploiting a large exogenous shock to the US agricultural labor supply caused by the termination of the Bracero agreements between the US and Mexico at the end of 1964. Using a text-search algorithm allocating patents to crops, I show a negative labor-supply shock induced a sharp increase in innovation in technologies related to more affected crops. The effect is stronger for technology related to labor-intensive production tasks. Farm-value dynamics indicate that, despite the positive technology reaction, the policy change was undesirable for farm owners. (JEL J22, J43, N32, O33, O34, Q12, Q16)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了劳动力供给对新技术创造的影响，利用1964年底美国和墨西哥之间布拉塞罗协议终止所导致的美国农业劳动力供给的巨大外生冲击。通过一种将专利分配到作物的文本搜索算法，我表明负向劳动力供给冲击引发了与受影响更严重作物相关的技术的急剧创新增加。这种效应在劳动密集型生产任务相关的技术中更为显著。农场价值动态表明，尽管存在积极的技术反应，政策变化对农场主来说仍是不利的。（JEL J22, J43, N32, O33, O34, Q12, Q16）

articles.title_en: The Effect of Immigration Restrictions on Local Labor Markets: Lessons from the 1920s Border Closure
articles.title_cn: 移民限制对地方劳动力市场的影响：来自1920年边境关闭的教训
articles.abstract_en: In the 1920s, the United States substantially reduced immigration by imposing country-specific entry quotas. We compare local labor markets differentially exposed to the quotas due to variation in the national-origin mix of their immigrant population. US-born workers in areas losing immigrants did not benefit relative to workers in less exposed areas. Instead, in urban areas, European immigrants were replaced with internal migrants and immigrants from Mexico and Canada. By contrast, farmers shifted toward capital-intensive agriculture, and the immigrant-intensive mining industry contracted. These differences highlight the uneven effects of the quota system at the local level. (JEL J15, J18, J31, K37, N32, N42, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 1920年，美国通过实施针对特定国家的入境配额大幅减少了移民。我们将因移民人口国籍构成差异而受到配额不同影响的当地劳动力市场进行比较。在失去移民的地区，美国出生的工人相对于受影响较小的地区的工人并未受益。相反，在城市地区，欧洲移民被国内移民以及来自墨西哥和加拿大的移民所取代。相比之下，农民转向资本密集型农业，而移民密集的采矿业则出现收缩。这些差异凸显了配额制度在地方层面的不均衡影响。（JEL J15, J18, J31, K37, N32, N42, R23）

articles.title_en: Temperature, Worker Productivity, and Adaptation: Evidence from Survey Data Production
articles.title_cn: 温度、工人生产率与适应：来自调查数据生产的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the impact of daily weather on worker productivity by using household survey data to study interviewers. Using data from over 9,000 Demographic and Health Surveys interviewers in 46 countries, I find that interviewers complete 13.6 percent fewer interviews per hour on the hottest and most humid days. Workers maintain the same total output by starting earlier in the day and spending more time on each interview at the expense of spending more hours in the field with the same total pay. In addition, interviewers become differentially less productive on tasks that are less easily monitored. (JEL C83, J22, J24, J81, O12, Q54)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用住户调查数据研究访问员，估计每日天气对工人生产率的影响。利用来自46个国家的超过9,000名人口与健康调查访问员的数据，我发现访问员在最炎热和最潮湿的日子里每小时完成的访谈数减少13.6%。工人通过更早开始工作并在每次访谈上花费更多时间来维持相同的总产出，但代价是在田间花费更多小时且总报酬不变。此外，访问员在较不易监督的任务上的生产率下降幅度更大。（JEL C83, J22, J24, J81, O12, Q54）

articles.title_en: Every Day Is Earth Day: Evidence on the Long-Term Impact of Environmental Activism
articles.title_cn: 每一天都是地球日：环境行动主义长期影响的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use variation in weather to study the long-term effects of activism during the original Earth Day on attitudes, environmental outcomes, and children’s health. Unusually bad weather on April 22, 1970 is associated with weaker support for the environment 10 to 20 years later, particularly among those who were school aged in 1970. Bad weather on Earth Day is also associated with higher levels of carbon monoxide in the air and greater risk of congenital abnormalities in infants born in the following decades. These results identify benefits to volunteer activity that would be impossible to identify until years after the volunteering occurs. (JEL D64, D91, Q51, Q53, Q54)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用天气变化来研究最初的地球日期间行动主义对态度、环境结果和儿童健康的长期影响。1970年四月22日异常恶劣的天气与10至20年后对环境支持力度减弱相关，尤其是在1970年处于学龄期的人群中。地球日的恶劣天气还与空气中一氧化碳水平升高以及随后几十年出生的婴儿先天性异常风险增加有关。这些结果识别了志愿活动的益处，而这些益处直到志愿活动发生多年后才能被识别。（JEL D64, D91, Q51, Q53, Q54）

articles.title_en: Incentivized Peer Referrals for Tuberculosis Screening: Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 结核病筛查的激励性同伴推荐：来自印度的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study whether and how peer referrals increase screening, testing, and identification of patients with tuberculosis, an infectious disease responsible for over one million deaths annually. In an experiment with 3,176 patients at 122 tuberculosis treatment centers in India, we find that small financial incentives raise the probability that existing patients refer prospective patients for screening and testing, resulting in cost-effective identification of new cases. Incentivized referrals operate through two mechanisms: peers have private information about individuals in their social networks to target for outreach, and they are more effective than health workers in inducing these individuals to get tested. (JEL H51, I12, I18, O15, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究同伴推荐是否以及如何提高结核病患者的筛查、检测和识别，结核病是一种每年导致超过一百万人死亡的传染病。在一项针对印度122个结核病治疗中心的3,176名患者的实验中，我们发现小额经济激励提高了现有患者推荐潜在患者进行筛查和检测的概率，从而以成本有效的方式识别新病例。激励性推荐通过两种机制发挥作用：同伴拥有关于其社交网络中个体私人信息以进行定向外展，并且他们在促使这些个体接受检测方面比卫生工作者更有效。（JEL H51, I12, I18, O15, Z13）

articles.title_en: Strategic Formal Layoffs: Unemployment Insurance and Informal Labor Markets
articles.title_cn: 战略性正式解雇：失业保险与非正规劳动力市场
articles.abstract_en: Exploiting an unemployment insurance reform in Brazil, we study incentive effects of UI in the presence of informal labor markets. We find that eligibility for UI benefits increases formal layoffs by 11 percent. Most of the additional layoffs are related to workers transitioning to informal employment. We further document formal layoff and recall patterns consistent with rent extraction from the UI system. Workers are laid off as they become eligible for UI benefits and recalled when benefits cease. These patterns are stronger for industries and municipalities with a high degree of labor market informality. (JEL J22, J46, J63, J65, K31, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用巴西的失业保险改革，我们研究了在存在非正规劳动力市场的情况下失业保险的激励效应。我们发现，失业保险金的领取资格使正式解雇增加了11%。大部分额外解雇与工人转向非正规就业有关。我们进一步记录了与从失业保险制度中提取租金相一致的正式解雇和召回模式。工人在有资格领取失业保险金时被解雇，并在福利停止时被召回。这些模式在劳动力市场非正规化程度较高的行业和城市更为明显。(JEL J22, J46, J63, J65, K31, O15)

articles.title_en: Inefficient Water Pricing and Incentives for Conservation
articles.abstract_en: Farmers often buy water using fixed fees—rather than with marginal prices. We use two randomized controlled trials in Bangladesh to study the relationship between marginal prices, adoption of a water-saving technology, and water usage. Our first experiment shows that the technology only saves water when farmers face marginal prices. Our second experiment finds that an encouragement to voluntarily convert to hourly pumping charges does not save water. Taken together, efforts to conserve water work best when farmers face marginal prices, but simply giving an option for marginal pricing is insufficient to trigger water-saving investments and reduce irrigation demands. (JEL O13, Q12, Q15, Q16, Q25)
articles.abstract_cn: 农民通常以固定费用而非边际价格购买水。我们在孟加拉国进行了两项随机对照试验，研究边际价格、节水技术采用与用水量之间的关系。我们的第一项实验表明，只有当农民面临边际价格时，该技术才能节约用水。第二项实验发现，鼓励自愿转换为按小时计收抽水费用并不能节约用水。综合来看，当农民面临边际价格时，节水努力最为有效，但仅仅提供边际定价的选择并不足以引发节水投资和减少灌溉需求。（JEL O13, Q12, Q15, Q16, Q25）

articles.title_en: High School Majors and Future Earnings
articles.abstract_en: We study how high school majors affect adult earnings using a regression discontinuity design. In Sweden students are admitted to majors in tenth grade based on their preference rankings and ninth grade GPA. We find engineering, natural science, and business majors yield higher earnings than social science and humanities, with major-specific returns also varying based on next-best alternatives. There is either a zero or a negative return to completing an academic program for students with a second-best nonacademic major. Most of the differences in adult earnings can be attributed to differences in occupation, and to a lesser extent, college major. (JEL I21, I26, J24, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用断点回归设计研究高中专业如何影响成年后的收入。在瑞典，学生根据其偏好排名和九年级平均绩点于十年级被录取至不同专业。我们发现，工程、自然科学和商科专业的收入高于社会科学和人文学科，且专业特定回报也因次优选择的不同而变化。对于次优选择为非学术性专业的学生，完成学术项目的回报要么为零，要么为负。成年收入的大部分差异可归因于职业差异，其次才是大学专业差异。(JEL I21, I26, J24, J31)

articles.title_en: The Effects of Working While in School: Evidence from Employment Lotteries
articles.title_cn: 在校期间工作的影响：来自就业抽签的证据
articles.abstract_en: Does working while in school smooth students’ transition into the labor market? We provide evidence on this question by leveraging a one-year work-study program that randomized job offers among over 90,000 student applicants in Uruguay. Program rules forbade employers from employing participants in the same job after program completion, and less than 5 percent of participants ever worked in the same firm again. Two years after the program, participants had 8 percent higher earnings. Our results suggest that the program’s focus on work-related skills was a key mechanism for earnings impacts. (JEL I21, I26, J13, J24, J31, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 在校期间工作是否能使学生的劳动力市场过渡更加平稳？我们利用乌拉圭一个为期一年的勤工助学项目为这一问题提供了证据，该项目在超过90,000名申请学生中随机分配了工作机会。项目规则禁止雇主在项目结束后继续雇用参与者从事同一工作，且不到5%的参与者曾在同一家公司再次工作。项目结束两年后，参与者的收入提高了8%。我们的结果表明，该项目对工作相关技能的重视是影响收入的关键机制。（JEL I21, I26, J13, J24, J31, O15）

articles.title_en: The Employee Costs of Corporate Debarment in Public Procurement
articles.title_cn: 公共采购中企业禁入的员工成本
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies an anticorruption policy—corporate debarment, or blacklisting—to understand how disclosing illicit corporate practices and the sanctions for these practices affect firm and worker outcomes. Exploiting a policy change in Brazil that imposed stricter penalties for corrupt firms, I find that debarment is associated with a sizable decline in employment and an increase in the probability of exiting the formal sector. I also document that workers’ annual earnings fall after debarment. The impacts are driven by lost revenues from government contracts. The results shed light on the costs to workers in weighing the consequences of corruption crackdown. (JEL D73, E26, H57, H83, J31, K42, O17)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一项反腐败政策——企业禁入，或称黑名单——以理解披露非法企业行为及其制裁如何影响企业和工人结果。利用巴西一项对腐败企业施加更严厉处罚的政策变化，我发现禁入与就业的大幅下降和退出正规部门概率的增加相关。我还记录了工人在禁入后年收入下降。这些影响是由政府合同收入损失驱动的。结果揭示了工人在权衡反腐败打击后果时所承担的成本。(JEL D73, E26, H57, H83, J31, K42, O17)

articles.title_en: The Economic Incidence of Wildfire Suppression in the United States
articles.title_cn: 美国野火扑救的经济归宿
articles.abstract_en: This study measures the degree to which public expenditures on wild-fire protection subsidize development in harm’s way. We use administrative data on firefighting expenditures to measure the causal effect of nearby homes on the amount spent to extinguish wildfires. We use these estimates in an actuarial calculation yielding geographically differentiated expected implicit subsidies for homes across the western United States. The expected net present value of this subsidy can exceed 20 percent of home value, increases with fire hazard, and decreases surprisingly steeply with development density. We discuss potential behavioral responses by individuals and local governments using a simple economic model. (JEL D91, Q23, Q54, R52, R58)
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究衡量了公共野火保护支出在多大程度上补贴了处于危险之中的开发。我们使用扑救支出的行政数据来衡量邻近房屋对扑灭野火支出金额的因果效应。我们利用这些估计进行精算计算，得出美国西部各地理差异化房屋的预期隐性补贴。该补贴的预期净现值可超过房屋价值的20%，随火灾危险增加而增加，并随开发密度增加而急剧下降。我们使用一个简单的经济模型讨论个人和地方政府的潜在行为反应。（JEL D91, Q23, Q54, R52, R58）

articles.title_en: Wage Stagnation and the Decline of Standardized Pay Rates, 1974–1991
articles.title_cn: 工资停滞与标准化工资率的下降，1974-1991
articles.abstract_en: Using new establishment-by-occupation microdata, we show that the use of discretionary wage setting significantly expanded in the 1970s and 1980s. Increasingly, wages for blue-collar workers were not standardized by job title or seniority but instead subject to managerial discretion. When establishments abandoned standardized pay rates, wages fell, particularly for the lowest-paid workers in a job and for those in establishments that previously paid above market rates. This shift away from standardized pay rates, in context of a broader decline in worker bargaining power, accelerated the decline in real wages experienced by blue-collar workers in the 1980s. (JEL J31, J33, J52, M52, O33)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用新的企业-职业微观数据，我们表明自由裁量工资设定的使用在1970年代和1980年代显著扩大。蓝领工人的工资越来越不按职位或资历标准化，而是受管理层自由裁量权支配。当企业放弃标准化工资率时，工资下降，尤其是对于工作中最低工资的工人以及那些先前支付高于市场工资的企业中的工人。这种从标准化工资率的转变，在工人议价能力更广泛下降的背景下，加速了1980年代蓝领工人实际工资的下降。(JEL J31, J33, J52, M52, O33)
